{{Quote|Maybe, if we fight hard and smart enough, slow it down to the point that we could contact the Alliance communications ship that's in orbit near Sullust, and get some kind of operational task force ordered out here.|[[Gennad Rozhdenst]]|<ref name="Hard Merchandise">''[[Hard Merchandise]]''</ref>}}
A '''communications ship''' attached to the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Rebel Alliance Fleet]] was stationed in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. It relayed news of the battle's proceedings to other [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] forces not present at Endor.
